en.headline: Ryan Choi reaches Asian Games men's foil final
en.dek: The Hong Kong fencer advanced to the individual foil final in Tokoname, guaranteeing at least a silver medal after Cheung Ka-long exited early.
body: Hong Kong fencer Ryan Choi Chun-yin reached the men's individual foil final at the Asian Games on Tuesday, locking in at least a silver medal for the city.

Choi advanced through the elimination rounds at the Aichi International Exhibition Center in Tokoname after Olympic champion Cheung Ka-long was eliminated in the round of 32. Choi will contest the gold-medal bout later in the session.
Hong Kong's fencing campaign continues with further individual and team events scheduled through the rest of the week.

zh.headline: 蔡俊彥亞運男子花劍個人賽晉身決賽
zh.dek: 港隊劍手蔡俊彥在常滑晉級男子個人花劍決賽，鎖定至少一面銀牌，張家朗早前止步32強。
body: 香港劍手蔡俊彥周二在亞運男子個人花劍賽事晉身決賽，為港隊鎖定至少一面銀牌。
賽事於常滑愛知國際展覽中心舉行。奧運金牌得主張家朗早前於32強出局，蔡俊彥一路晉級至決賽，稍後將爭奪金牌。
港隊劍擊隊本周仍有其他個人及團體賽事。
